subject: Re: Cedarcrest security intake — SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & portal access
messages:

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Cedarcrest intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Hi Anika — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Cedarcrest priorities: SOC 2 Type II evidence for data handling, confirmation of HIPAA/GDPR scoping, and a short bridge letter for procurement.
- Redwood asks: access to your Trust Portal (or an upload link) so we can submit our SOC 2 Type II report and any supplementary attestations. If possible, we also need a point of contact for the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ).

Next steps I propose:
1) You open Trust Portal access for Redwood (logan.wright@redwood.ai) so we can upload the report and bridge letter.
2) We’ll attach our SOC 2 Type II report (2026) and a one-page bridge letter summarizing scope & retention.
3) Sean will coordinate the VSQ and provide answers within 3 business days once the portal link is available.

Can you confirm who on your side will own portal provisioning and whether legal needs anything redacted before upload? Happy to provide a draft bridge letter for your legal team to review.

Thanks — Logan

--
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@cedarcresthealth.com>

Cc: Michael Perez <security@cedarcresthealth.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@cedarcresthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cedarcrest intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Thanks Logan — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Portal provisioning: I’ll request an upload invite from our Trust Portal admin (Michael). Michael can grant access and set the upload TTL.
- VSQ: We typically send an initial questionnaire via SecureQ (our vendor portal) before we permit full uploads. The VSQ should take ~30–45 minutes to complete; legal may request narrow redactions but we can work that out.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We confirmed during the call that PHI could be in scope for some integrations; our compliance team will mark which controls require HIPAA-specific evidence.

I’ll loop Michael and legal. Expect the portal invite (or next steps) by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Anika Rao
Senior Procurement Manager | Cedarcrest Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cedarcrest intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Marissa / Sean — forwarding Anika’s reply. Action items for us: 

- Marissa: please prepare a 1-page bridge letter (scope, period covered by SOC 2 Type II 2026, hosting regions, data processing notes re: PHI) and attach as a .docx + PDF. I’ve included a checklist CSV stub (see attachments) with likely evidence paths (logs, IAM policy, backup schedule).
- Sean: be ready to complete the VSQ once Anika/Michael share the SecureQ link. I estimate 30–60 minutes. Also gather the exact SSO/SCIM documentation and KMS key descriptions — Cedarcrest flagged key management specifically.

Goal: have the bridge letter + SOC 2 report queued for upload within 48 hours of the portal invite. If Cedarcrest requires redaction prior to upload, we’ll pre-redact and send a clean copy to legalops@cedarcresthealth.com.

Any blockers? If not, I’ll draft the bridge letter template and send to Marissa this morning.

— Logan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700

Ack — I’m on it. Attached a first-pass bridge letter (redwood_bridge_letter_draft_v1.docx) and a short evidence checklist CSV. Notes: 
- Bridge letter includes exact scope dates, statement about no external data-sharing, and retention/backup locations (us-west-2 primary).
- I added a short paragraph about our quantization/embedding telemetry being aggregated and non-PII by default, but flagged it for review by legal if Cedarcrest treats some telemetry as PHI.

I’ll wait for the portal link; if Cedarcrest insists on pre-upload redaction we can produce a redacted PDF within 2 hours.

— Marissa
